gloss: accounts payable; money owed to suppliers

definitions.explanation: Money a business owes for goods or services it has already received on credit. A standard balance-sheet liability, and the counterpart of {売掛金|うりかけきん}.

examples.japanese: {買掛金|かいかけきん}を{支払|しはら}う。
{仕入先|しいれさき}への{買掛金|かいかけきん}が{今月末|こんげつまつ}に{期限|きげん}を{迎|むか}える。
examples.english: The payable to our supplier comes due at the end of this month.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}を{増|ふ}やしたので、{買掛金|かいかけきん}の{残高|ざんだか}も{大|おお}きくなった。
examples.english: We built up inventory, so the accounts payable balance grew as well.

examples.japanese: {買掛金|かいかけきん}の{支払|しはら}いを{遅|おく}らせると、{取引先|とりひきさき}との{信用|しんよう}に{関|かか}わる。
examples.english: Delaying payment of accounts payable affects your credibility with business partners.

notes:
Formed from {買|か}い (buying) + {掛|か}け (on credit) + {金|きん} (money). Refers specifically to what is owed on ordinary purchases of goods for resale or production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買掛金|かいかけきん}を{支払|しはら}う: to pay accounts payable
- {買掛金|かいかけきん}の{残高|ざんだか}: payables balance
- {買掛金|かいかけきん}が{膨|ふく}らむ: for payables to swell

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {売掛金|うりかけきん}: accounts receivable — the mirror image, money owed to the business
- {未払金|みばらいきん}: accrued payable — money owed for something other than ordinary purchases
- {借入金|かりいれきん}: borrowings — money owed to a lender rather than a supplier
